crossRefs.note: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.

translations.web: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.
translations.bsb: Set the grate beneath the ledge of the altar, so that the mesh comes halfway up the altar.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.
translations.asv: And thou shalt put it under the ledge round the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.
